description: Versions des horaires théoriques des lignes de bus et de métro du réseau STAR dans les formats GTFS et NETEX ainsi que les URLs d'accès au GTFS-RT is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des GTFS et NETEX du réseau STAR ainsi que les urls d'accès au GTFS-RT ---- Liste des GTFS ---- Un GTFS présente la description de l'offre horaire théorique bus et métro du réseau STAR sur une période de validité. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité, Transport. The portal shows 4 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2014-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
